now.title: Spider-Man (1994)
now.text: In episode 64, on the Beyonder's world, he fights beside Spider-Man's team and goes home with no memory of it.

proposed.text: In episode 63, on the Beyonder's world, he fights beside Spider-Man's team and goes home with no memory of it.

changes.evidence: The Secret Wars arc is episodes 61-63. In episode 63 ("Chapter III: Doom") the heroes defeat Doom and the Beyonder erases the others' memories and sends them back to Earth. Episode 64 ("I Really, Really Hate Clones") begins the Spider Wars arc, which Iron Man is not part of.

now.title: Spider-Man (1994)
now.text: In episode 63, on the Beyonder's world, the Invisible Woman and Storm recharge a lab to help Spider-Man's team.

proposed.text: In episode 61, on the Beyonder's world, the Invisible Woman and Storm recharge a lab to help Spider-Man's team.

changes.evidence: The lab recharge happens in episode 61 ("Chapter I: Arrival"): 'Storm and Invisible Woman combine their abilities to recharge the laboratory.' Episode 63 ("Chapter III: Doom") is about the Thing's kidnapping and the fight with Doom, so the record's only event is not in episode 63.
